title: Stage 1 adaptive send-path policy verification
scope: Verify the common unified evidence contract and force, observe, shadow, latch, safety, outcome, replay, and force-legacy rollback behavior for all four Stage 1 send-path axes. Do not claim a policy winner, throughput or latency improvement, active behavior, production readiness, or an ML-derived rule.
verification_method: Canonical SpecTrace validation, deterministic requirement-home and bounded property tests, focused scheduler and lifecycle correctness tests, manual or nightly mechanism-cost benchmarks outside correctness CI, one small permanent unified four-axis smoke, schema and checksum validation, and deterministic replay.
preconditions: The receive-credit and stream-capacity correctness checkpoint remains preserved.
The accepted oversized-write selector and send-turn force and shadow checkpoints remain preserved.
The stopped application-send-turn-only normalization remains diagnostic_incomplete and is not restarted.
Every Stage 1 campaign varies at most one axis while all adjacent applied values remain legacy_current.
Active_internal and production activation remain unauthorized.
procedure: Validate SPEC-QUIC-CRT-STAGE1-SEND-PATH, ARC-QUIC-CRT-0066, WI-QUIC-CRT-0067, and VER-QUIC-CRT-0068 individually against the canonical model and check reciprocal trace links.
Build the relevant projects in Release before every focused test slice.

Run REQ-QUIC-CRT-0177 tests for canonical axis order, closed values, one forced axis, adjacent legacy_current, safety override, version, provenance, decision kind, deterministic join, duplicate, mismatch, shadow-neutrality, and force-legacy behavior.

Run REQ-QUIC-CRT-0178 tests for legacy_current and single_eligible batch values, packet-plan latch, legal-prefix validation, payload, ordering, FIN, ownership, cancellation, disposal, lifecycle, recovery, congestion, pacing, flow-control, queue, buffer, terminal, replay, and rollback behavior.

Run REQ-QUIC-CRT-0179 tests for legacy_current and single_datagram burst values, actor-turn latch, lower-only safety guards, handshake, recovery, congestion, pacing, anti-amplification, retransmission, endpoint, terminal, replay, and rollback behavior.

Run REQ-QUIC-CRT-0180 tests for every oversized-write value, admission latch, quantum validation, byte identity and order, continuation, ownership, cancellation, disposal, reset, FIN, shutdown, recovery, flow-control, terminal, exactly-once completion, replay, and rollback behavior.
Run bounded property sequences for duplicate, delayed, missing, stale, saturated, contradictory, out-of-domain, out-of-order, terminal, cancellation, disposal, reset, loss, and recovery events.
Run focused BenchmarkDotNet mechanism and allocation checks only through manual or nightly performance workflows.
Run the complete correctness-only Release suite with performance categories excluded.

Run one small permanent correctness-only smoke and require every unified row to contain all four axis records, exactly one varied axis, adjacent legacy_current applied values, exact forced and applied joins, shadow neutrality, and append-only exclusions.
Validate raw artifacts, decision records, results, unified epochs, manifests, checksums, classifications, and deterministic replay before proceeding to Stage 2.
expected_result: Every Stage 1 axis is independently forceable, observable, shadow-evaluable, safely latched, attributable, replayable, and rollback-tested while one stable correctness-critical runtime remains authoritative; every smoke row contains all four axes with at most one varied treatment and all adjacent axes applied as legacy_current; safety guards remain authoritative under forcing; invalid and negative evidence remains append-only; and no active behavior or production rule is authorized.
status_summary: In progress. All four Stage 1 axes are independently forceable, observable, and shadow-evaluable. The common snapshot now distinguishes actual forced send-turn application from neutral shadow recommendation. A connection-local bounded accumulator consumes all four evidence sinks, emits exactly four summaries per epoch, resets at the boundary, and marks a missing boundary event as missing and unlatched instead of fabricating an operation or carrying prior evidence as fresh. The permanent raw QUIC host now enables all four observation streams whenever any Stage 1 axis is selected, permits at most one forced axis, holds receive credit at legacy_current, emits detailed axis events, and emits the versioned unified raw epoch at the existing connection epoch boundary. The raw and curated schemas accept explicit epoch_summary decision joins with null operation and plan keys. The focused REQ-QUIC-CRT-0177 accumulator, configuration, serialization, schema, and semantic tests are green. Canonical raw-to-curated materialization, permanent campaign extraction, manual or nightly mechanism-cost evidence, the complete Release correctness suite, multi-host verification, and the small four-axis smoke remain open. No policy acceptance, rule derivation, active behavior, or production readiness is claimed.
